# MuAPI

Generate images and discover supported models through MuAPI's OpenAI-compatible API.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/muapi/.

## Actions

- **Estimate Model Cost** (read-only): Price a native catalog model run before submitting it.
- **Generate Image**: Generate one or more images from a text prompt through MuAPI's OpenAI-compatible API.
- **Get Catalog Model** (read-only): Get one native catalog model by name, including its pricing and the provider-defined input and output schemas.
- **List Catalog Models** (read-only): Browse MuAPI's full native model catalog with per-model pricing, category, family and group.
- **List Models** (read-only): Return the image-generation models available through MuAPI's OpenAI-compatible API.
